recommendation: Keep the audit commit. Do not restore the historical status-not-taken explanation unless Pharmacy explicitly requests a new migration note phrased around the current adherence model.
issue_request: FHIR-19654 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy issue asking to explain why STU3 MedicationStatement.taken was removed and replaced with status not-taken.
initial_application: The historical implementation commit cdb9b154325715da80c5913ec7939955b7d52105, merged by ec284380a4c273eeee93dc77e0ead3366dddec01, added the requested note to the old MedicationStatement spreadsheet source: the Taken attribute was removed to align with Workflow and replaced with not-Taken status.
additional_context: The linked 2018 Zulip thread confirms that original rationale. Later Published Pharmacy decisions FHIR-19468 and FHIR-19470 removed not-taken from status and introduced/renamed adherence for taken/not-taken semantics. FHIR-39271 later confirmed that MedicationStatement.status reflects recording status while MedicationStatement.adherence carries taking/not-taking information.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Reintroducing the old explanation would be stale and misleading in the current build, where active MedicationStatement source already points to adherence and includes a not-taking adherence code.

related_jiras.note: Removed not-taken from MedicationUsage.status and directed use of an adherence attribute for taken/not-taken.

Confirmed the current status/adherence split for MedicationStatement and is already represented on the combined branch.
Changed stale effective[x] wording away from the removed taken field toward adherence.
